[ITST.10.11] **Each libds fuzz target has figures of its own.** Beside the
two of [ITST.10.2], libds must report a line and a branch figure for each fuzz
target in `runtime/tests/fuzz/`. A measurement takes each over one
instrumented build of the commit under test, counting that target's replay of
its seeds alone, each seed once. Each figure is held by a floor as [ITST.10.4]
states. A replay that fails, or that runs fewer inputs than its seeds, must
fail the measurement and give no figure.
